title: Ovecc architecture contract
description: Schema for .ovecc/architecture.toml: the intended architecture as code. Components are matched to files by path globs; depends_on is the allow-list of legal component dependencies. See docs/COMMANDS.md#ovecc-architecture-init---force.

mode.description: Enforcement mode. warn reports everything at low severity and never gates; new-violations and strict differ once the baseline store exists.

unassigned.description: What to do with indexed files no component claims.

component.description: The declared components. Rules reference components only by name; paths live solely in each component's paths.

name.description: Unique component name, referenced by depends_on entries.

role.description: Free-form label for humans and agents (e.g. domain, adapter, entrypoint). Not enforced.

paths.description: Path globs claiming files for this component. * stays inside one path segment, ** crosses segments; the most specific glob wins across components.

depends_on.description: The only components this one may depend on. An import to any other component is a divergence.

deprecated.description: Still legal, but reported so the entry can eventually be dropped.

cannot_depend_on.description: Components this one must never depend on. An allow-list already forbids by omission; naming the prohibition reports the edge as a forbidden dependency rather than an undeclared one. Naming the same component here and in depends_on or must_depend_on is a contract error.

consumed_by.description: The only components allowed to depend on this one, declared on the target. An empty list closes the component to everybody - the strangler-fig rule for a module on its way out. Omit to leave it unrestricted. A dependency this list does not admit is a contract error, not a finding.

must_depend_on.description: Components every file of this one must depend on, judged per file. Files that import nothing at all are exempt. Implies permission, so a required dependency is never also a divergence.

interface.description: Public entry files. When non-empty, other components may import only these paths; anything else is an interface bypass. Virtual: no barrel file required.

external_deny.description: External specifier patterns this component must not import (e.g. a pure-logic component banning DB clients).

slices.description: Isolate the component's slices: each first-level directory under the glob prefix is a slice, and slices must not import each other. A slice exposes a public API for a neighbour under <neighbour>/@x/<slice>.

deny_capabilities.description: Ambient capabilities this component must not use, matched against a curated JS/TS API basket (globals, ambient receivers, constructors, and node builtins).

max_cyclomatic.description: Per-function McCabe cyclomatic budget for the component. A function above it is a complexity-budget verdict. At least 1.

max_cognitive.description: Per-function SonarSource cognitive budget for the component. A function above it is a complexity-budget verdict.
